capabilities: Create media notes from YouTube pages via a bookmarklet
Control media playback with hotkeys without leaving the note
Insert clickable timestamp links that seek the player
Resume playback from where the video left off
Customize player layout, size, and timestamp format in settings
extras: Currently only YouTube is supported; support for other media providers is listed as planned on the roadmap. Feedback is collected via an external form.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play video or audio in a note pane and capture timestamped references while writing.

relations.evidence: capture and replay insights from YouTube videos, podcasts, and lectures into your knowledge base

summary: Adds media notes with an embedded player for YouTube videos and podcasts, controlled by hotkeys and clickable timestamp links.
